name: sunflower

purpose.why: Rebuilt on Evan's request (2026-10-22) to replace the Ranch tile's original model with a crafted one, keeping its game role.
purpose.audience: children building and playing in a miniature ranch
purpose.style: normal (upgrade: the same asset, built better)

brief.prompt: a single tall sunflower with a big yellow flower head and broad leaves on a sturdy stem

concept.tool: Midjourney web app (midjourney.com/imagine), driven in Evan's signed-in Chrome by Claude through the Claude in Chrome extension, one job at a time, text prompts only (no image reference)

hero.prompt: a single tall sunflower with a big yellow flower head and broad leaves on a sturdy stem, stylized 3D game asset, low-poly diorama style, flat painted colors, soft studio lighting, plain warm cream background, centered, full object visible, no text --ar 1:1
hero.pick_reason: big face-on flower head, broad leaves on a sturdy stem, centered and whole

construction.by: modeler agent, directed by the art director (Claude)

rounds.change: First build from hero measurements (6 leaves, 2 petal rings, disc, wavy stalk, dirt patch); fixed a petiole midpoint bug that spiked the bounds.
Leaves re-placed from the overlay: upper-right up and flatter, upper-left lower and further out, right leaf back up, left leaf lower; thicker stalk; flatter wider soil.
Less droop on the side leaves, wider upper-left leaf, head shifted left; stalk and soil shifted left to match the hero's offset.
Third petal ring, broader petals, darker leaf green and deeper gold, flatter disc dip, coarser stalk to stay in budget.
Head petals slightly shorter (a longer head lost 0.04), right leaf more horizontal, front leaf right; seed sweep showed +-0.003 noise.
Uniform scale to the old GLB's 1.585 m height, base clamped to z = 0; final 768 px / 48 sample render and hero check.

what_was_done: No turnaround for this job, so it is scored on the hero alone. make_views.py keys the hero against both edges of the backdrop and drops the soft grey ground shadow (near the ground only saturated pixels in a band round the stalk are kept), giving views/hero.png.

hero_check.py renders front-on, 5 deg up, with the harness lens (YAW 0, ELEV 5), as the hero is drawn nearly level. A calibration grid over yaw -20..20 and elevation 0..12 put yaw 0 / elev 0-5 at the top, so the direction was held there.

One 6-sided faceted tube (Stem_Green) along a slightly wavy centreline taken from the hero, radius 3.4 cm at the base tapering to 2.4 cm under the head, standing on a 9-sided irregular, slightly domed dirt patch (Soil_Dirt) about 30 x 22 cm.

Six heart-shaped leaf cards (Leaf_Green, 18 triangles each, double-sided) with lobes reaching back past the petiole, folded along a centre crease and drooping towards the tip, on short 3-sided petioles. Placed from the hero: upper right just under the head, a big front-facing upper-left leaf with a smaller one behind it, a right leaf mid-stalk, a left leaf below it and a front leaf low down, all turned to face the viewer and a little up.

A face-forward head tilted 8 deg down, about 0.53 m across (a third of the height): a 12-sided Seed_Brown disc with a raised rim, a shallow trough and a low dome; three rings of pointed, ridged petals (8 triangles each: a raised midrib and a faceted tip), 22 Petal_Amber behind and 20 + 20 Petal_Gold in front with alternating offsets, so the edge reads as layered petals; a green receptacle cone closes the back where the stalk enters.

905 triangles (budget 1k), 7 meshes, one flat material each: Stem_Green, Leaf_Green, Petal_Gold, Petal_Amber, Seed_Brown, Soil_Dirt. The plant is scaled so its top sits at 1.585 m like GF-567.glb (to_game copies the GLB with no rescale); 0.58 x 0.23 x 1.585 m, origin at the base on the ground. No animation, no variants (plant group).
construction.creative_additions: A third, offset ring of gold petals so the head edge reads layered as in the hero, and a green receptacle closing the back of the head for the game's other angles.

geometry.up: Z (Blender source); Y in GLB and game
geometry.origin: centre of the footprint, on the ground

good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.79 with a matched front-on camera: the head size and height, the stalk and the alternating leaf placement line up with the hero almost leaf for leaf.
Reads as a sunflower at a glance: a big gold disc of layered petals with a dark centre on a tall green stalk with broad hearts of leaves.
Within budget at 905 triangles, most of it on the petals (496) and leaves and petioles.
off: The hero's petals are softer and more crumpled, with many more facets; mine are 8-triangle ridged cards, crisper and a touch more regular.
The hero's seed disc shows a darker hollow centre; with one flat Seed_Brown material mine reads the rim and dip by shading only.

Footprint: width 0.58 m matches the old 0.60 m, but depth is 0.23 m against the old 0.59 m. The hero draws a flat, face-forward plant with leaves to the left and right, so I kept it flat rather than spreading leaves front to back.
Seed_Brown matches none of the game's role words (to_game role 'plain'), as the art director named it; Flower_Seed would make it foliage-recoloured if wanted.

rights: Original work for Abbie's World. Concept art generated on Evan's Midjourney account; geometry generated procedurally, no third-party meshes or textures.
